title: How Trump can get himself out of his Ukrainian pickle
description: Moves by the Trump administration are calling into question 11 years of US opposition to Russia’s aggression against Ukraine, which could hurt President Donald Trump and jeopardize prospects for peace. But there's a way out for Trump and Ukrainian President Vladimir Zelensky.

title: Trump criticises Starmer and Macron over Ukraine war
description: Trump said he believes Russia and Ukraine would not enter peace talks without his involvement.

title: U.N. Resolution Standoff: U.S. and Ukraine Clash Over Peace Proposal
description: The U.S. and Ukraine face a diplomatic standoff at the U.N. over respective resolutions marking the anniversary of Russia's invasion of Ukraine. While President Trump seeks to broker peace, tension arises with Kyiv and the EU. The proposals reflect contrasting approaches to ending the conflict and maintaining international peace.

title: Trump Urges Unity for Peace in Ukraine
description: U.S. President Donald Trump has encouraged Russian and Ukrainian leaders to collaborate for peace, while noting Russia's interest in a deal. The U.S. is nearing a minerals agreement with Ukraine. Trump has been advocating for an end to the war in Ukraine, holding talks and communications with involved parties.

title: US Secretary of State slams Zelenskyy for ‘hustling’ US by rejecting minerals deal
description: Rubio stated that Zelenskyy’s actions had left him, Vice President JD Vance, and Russia-Ukraine special envoy Keith Kellogg frustrated, following their discussions with the Ukrainian leader at the Munich Security Conference.

title: Ukrainians call on Canada for help after three years of war
description: As Ukraine marks three years since Russia’s full-scale invasion on Monday, people on the ground are calling on Canadians not to give up on their fight for freedom.

title: After three years of full-scale war, Ukrainians call on Canada to help them carry on
description: OTTAWA — As Ukraine marks three years since Russia's full-scale invasion on Monday, people on the ground are calling on Canadians not to give up on their fight for freedom. Here are three perspectives, from different parts of Ukraine.
